history.summary: Meyer Blue (D15, FH, 2028 TOP) 4BR, 1,518 sqft at $4.4M / $2,899 psf near Katong Park MRT — a premium freehold new launch priced ~9% below the project's $3,190 URA median. Strong location and tenure, but the >$4.4M quantum and new-launch bias make it a poor 5–7yr investment despite the sub-median PSF.
history.rating_rationale: Listed PSF ($2,899) is ~9% below the project's robust 176-transaction URA median ($3,190), which is the one genuinely attractive feature — and 570m to the new Katong Park MRT (TEL) in freehold East Coast is prime. But the $4.4M quantum sits well into the >$3M zone where the buyer pool thins sharply for resale, new_launch_bias is flagged (paying a fresh-launch premium), completion is 2028 (capital tied up, SSD window), and score_1000 of 416 reflects weak risk-adjusted value at this entry. A trophy own-stay candidate more than a 5–7yr investment — Neutral.
